title: Argument Quality Annotation and Gender Bias Detection in Financial Communication through Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial attacks via prompt injection where arguments are attributed to a specific gender (female or male company representative) alongside a prejudice sentence as a bias trigger. Bias is quantified by measuring the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and the directional shift in argument quality assessment scores (strength, specificity, persuasiveness, and objectivity) before and after the attack.
